title: Introducing Easy Lens CLI: Create Snapchat Lenses with the AI Coding Assistant You Already Use
summary: Today, we're introducing Easy Lens CLI, a new way for developers to build Snapchat Lenses with the AI coding assistants
body_markdown:
Today, we're introducing Easy Lens CLI, a new way for developers to build Snapchat Lenses with the AI coding assistants they already work with, like Claude Code, Codex and Cursor. Easy Lens CLI is available now and free to use with a Snapchat account.


Easy Lens already makes it simple to create a Lens from a single prompt on web and mobile. Easy Lens CLI brings that same creation flow into the tools developers use every day, so their AI assistant can take on the technical work while they focus on the creative vision.


*Lenses created by*[Reem Ali](https://www.snapchat.com/@trend.vip?lang=en-US)


**Bring Your Own AI**


With Easy Lens CLI, there's no new tool to learn. Developers describe the Lens they want in plain words, and their AI assistant handles every step:


-


**Build:** Pull from more than 100 AR building blocks and more than 50 AI asset generators


-


**Test:** Render preview videos and send Lenses straight to your phone to try them out


-


**Publish:** Share Lenses to Snapchat and track how they perform, all in the same session


**From Ideas to Published Lenses in Hours**


With Easy Lens CLI, developers can build everything from Web Lens games with leaderboards to camera Lenses and beauty effects. Their AI assistants can generate assets, build and test each Lens, fix errors along the way and send new versions to their phone in minutes. That means a full game can go from an idea to a published Lens in a single day, without writing any code.


**Built for Game Makers, Creators and Brands**


Game developers can bring browser games they've already made to Snapchat as Web Lenses, putting them in front of a daily audience with built-in sharing. AI creators can bring in assets from their favorite tools and ship Lenses in their own signature style. And agencies can turn existing campaign videos, images and brand assets into AR Lenses in a fraction of the usual production time.


**The Same Standards, With Real Reach**


Lenses made with Easy Lens CLI go through the same content checks, Lens review and publishing path as Lenses made in the Easy Lens apps. Once published, they can reach Snapchatters right away, and developers[enrolled in Lens+ Payouts](https://developers.snap.com/lens-studio/monetization/lens-creator-rewards/lens-plus-payouts?lang=en-US) can earn from the Lenses they create. Last month we awarded $1.8M in payouts to Lens+ community creators.


**Getting Started**


Easy Lens CLI runs on Mac, Windows and Linux. To get started, visit[easylens.snapchat.com/cli](https://easylens.snapchat.com/cli?af_xp=custom&pid=Blog&shortlink=blog&source_caller=ui&onelink_id=9CgJ&c=Blog&lang=en-US) to install the tool, sign in with Snapchat and connect your coding assistant.


We can't wait to see what developers create when their favorite AI tools can build for Snapchat.
